import json,os,secrets,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/shihongye/data1/servicemind')
state=Path.home()/'.local/state/servicemind/local-evaluation-r3'
if os.environ.get('R3_DEPLOYED_FIXTURE'):
 state=Path(os.environ['LOCAL_EVALUATION_STATE'])
private=state/'smoke-environment.json'
if sys.argv[1]=='prepare':
 e=json.loads((state/'environment.json').read_text())
 for k in ['SERVICEMIND_DATABASE_URL','SERVICEMIND_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL']:
  e[k]=e[k].rsplit('/',1)[0]+'/smoke_evaluation'
 e.update(DATABASE_TYPE='postgres',POSTGRES_DB='smoke_evaluation',USE_FAKE_MODEL='true',DEFAULT_MODEL='fake',SERVICEMIND_MODEL_ALLOWED_PROVIDERS='fake',SERVICEMIND_MODEL_ALLOWED_MODELS='fake',SERVICEMIND_GENERIC_API_ENABLED='true',AUTH_SECRET=secrets.token_urlsafe(24),AGENT_URL='http://127.0.0.1:18081',R3_DEPLOYED_FIXTURE='1',SMOKE_THREAD_ID='r3-smoke-'+secrets.token_hex(8))
 subprocess.run(['docker','exec','servicemind-local-eval-r3-pg','createdb','-U','eval_admin','smoke_evaluation'],check=True,capture_output=True)
 subprocess.run([str(root/'.venv/bin/alembic'),'upgrade','head'],env=e,cwd=root,check=True,capture_output=True)
 sql='GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO eval_app; GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO eval_app; GRANT USAGE,SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO eval_app;'
 subprocess.run(['docker','exec','-i','servicemind-local-eval-r3-pg','psql','-U','eval_admin','-d','smoke_evaluation'],input=sql,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
 private.write_text(json.dumps(e));private.chmod(0o600)
 print('Dedicated smoke database prepared')
elif not os.environ.get('R3_DEPLOYED_FIXTURE'):
 e=json.loads(private.read_text());os.execve(sys.executable,[sys.executable,__file__,*sys.argv[1:]],e)
elif sys.argv[1]=='serve':
 from service.service import create_app
 import uvicorn
 (state/'smoke.pid').write_text(str(os.getpid()))
 uvicorn.run(create_app(),host='127.0.0.1',port=18081,timeout_graceful_shutdown=5)
elif sys.argv[1]=='test':
 os.execvpe('pytest',['pytest','--run-docker','-m','deployed_stack','-q','--junitxml=evaluation/security/completion_2026-10-22_r3/deployed-junit.xml'],dict(os.environ))
